question: Should this protected lifecycle-test refactor be refreshed against current main and accepted as the canonical consolidation of these regression suites?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires human handling, and the branch is behind a current main branch that already shows overlapping consolidation patterns; automation should not decide whether the remaining diff is still worth landing.

options.title: Refresh and merge if equivalent
options.body: Rebase onto current main and merge if the resulting diff remains test-only and retains the stated lifecycle assertions and coverage.

options.title: Close as redundant after comparison
options.body: Close only if a maintainer confirms the refreshed comparison shows current main already contains the full useful consolidation.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge if equivalent
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and merge if the resulting diff remains test-only and retains the stated lifecycle assertions and coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active lifecycle-test consolidation and are the only concrete area contact established by the supplied PR evidence.
